Zaril's chat: exactly what the fix changes

The fix as rebuilt today (commit b38255a, disc ba971011). It changes four of the fourteen chat blocks and nothing else: blocks 0-5, 7, 8, 11 and 12 play exactly as the game shipped them. No text changes here; only which line plays where. Every line stays with its own speaker.

The one related text change is separate and already reviewed: the topic line 5:98 now reads “We asked if they had any new information.” (it was “We asked if they had any news.”). It shows on both sides below, since both were captured on the current disc.

Every value the fix changes

Seven numbers in the chat table in MCARD, read from the original and the built file. A topic line or spoken line is an NPC_MES5 index; an expression picks Fritillaria’s portrait.
